mostWorthwhile.text: Building supporting tissue from collagen-producing fibroblasts was most worthwhile: the sequence connects selected gene activity, protein secretion and the organization of cells with extracellular matrix.

leastWorthwhile.text: Combining fibroblasts with the matrix they had just produced felt somewhat repetitive, although the resulting tissue view clarified their arrangement.

arbitrary.text: Recombining fibroblasts with their own matrix felt a little artificial, even though its purpose was to show the organized tissue.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue to see how the separate myoblasts develop into muscle; that unfinished construction provides a clear next question.
